tagline.en: The San Diego Freeway: Los Angeles bypassed on its western side
tagline.zh: 圣迭戈高速公路：从西侧绕开洛杉矶市区

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

start.zh: 奥兰治县尔湾，与 I-5 相接

end.en: I-5 near San Fernando, Los Angeles County
end.zh: 洛杉矶县圣费尔南多附近，与 I-5 相接

en: I-405 leaves I-5 at Irvine, runs west and then north behind the coastal cities of Orange County, passes east of Long Beach and the South Bay, threads the gap between Los Angeles International Airport and the Westside, climbs the Santa Monica Mountains at Sepulveda Pass, crosses the San Fernando Valley and rejoins I-5 near San Fernando. The even hundreds digit is the clue to the job: a three-digit Interstate beginning with an even number is a loop that leaves its parent route and returns to it, and this one bypasses downtown Los Angeles entirely on the western side.

Almost nothing about it feels like a bypass. The freeway runs eight to fourteen lanes wide past some of the densest employment in California — the airport, Santa Monica, Century City, UCLA — and the Sepulveda Pass segment is the only north–south freeway crossing the Santa Monica Mountains between the Valley and the Westside. Traffic between US 101 and I-10 averages 289,000 vehicles a day, more than the road was designed to carry, and the interchanges at either end of the pass are routinely listed among the most congested freeway junctions in the country.
zh: I-405 在尔湾离开 I-5，先向西、再向北，从奥兰治县沿海各市的内侧绕过，经长滩与南湾以东，从洛杉矶国际机场与西城之间穿过，在塞普尔韦达山口翻越圣莫尼卡山，横穿圣费尔南多谷，最后在圣费尔南多附近回到 I-5。编号中的偶数百位说明了它的角色：以偶数开头的三位数州际公路是离开母线之后还要回到母线的环线，而这一条从西侧完全绕开了洛杉矶市中心。
但它几乎没有一点绕行线的样子。这条高速有八到十四条车道，穿过加州就业最密集的一片地区——机场、圣莫尼卡、世纪城、加州大学洛杉矶分校；塞普尔韦达山口路段是圣费尔南多谷与西城之间唯一一条翻越圣莫尼卡山的南北向高速。US 101 与 I-10 之间的日均交通量为 289,000 辆，已超出道路的设计通行能力，山口两端的立交也常年出现在全美最拥堵高速枢纽的名单上。

en: The corridor was approved as a chargeable Interstate in 1955 and construction began in 1957 with a section near Los Angeles International Airport. The hard part was the mountains. Work on the Sepulveda Pass crossing started in August 1960 and the new freeway opened on 21 December 1962 — a $20-million job that the Los Angeles Times later described as the most expensive state highway project in California to that date. The route took its present number in California's 1964 highway renumbering.

The Orange County half was assembled one contract at a time over thirteen years. The last piece, eight miles running southeast to meet I-5 at Irvine, was dedicated on 6 December 1968 and carried traffic from January 1969. From then on the road existed as a continuous alternative to I-5 through the western half of the metropolitan area, and the suburbs it was built to serve filled in along both sides of it.
zh: 这条走廊在 1955 年获批列入可动用联邦资金的州际公路，1957 年从洛杉矶国际机场附近的一段开始施工。难的是山。塞普尔韦达山口段于 1960 年 8 月动工，新高速于 1962 年 12 月 21 日通车——这项工程耗资 2,000 万美元，《洛杉矶时报》后来称其为当时加州造价最高的州级公路工程。1964 年加州公路重新编号时，本路线取得了现在的号码。
奥兰治县那一半，是一份合同接一份合同、用十三年拼起来的。最后一段长八英里，向东南延伸至尔湾与 I-5 相接，于 1968 年 12 月 6 日举行通车典礼，1969 年 1 月开放通行。自此，这条路成为大都会区西半部一条与 I-5 平行的完整通道，它本要服务的郊区也在两侧一路填满。

en: The most expensive thing ever done to I-405 was adding one lane. Metro awarded the Sepulveda Pass Improvements contract to Kiewit in April 2009 with a life-of-project budget of $1,034 million, to build a ten-mile northbound carpool lane between I-10 and US 101, rebuild bridges and ramps, and raise miles of retaining and sound walls. The lane opened on 23 May 2014, more than a year late, and the work reached substantial completion in September 2015.

Then the bill arrived. Metro and its contractor went to binding arbitration over delay and disruption claims, and in December 2016 the Metro board raised the final life-of-project budget by $297.8 million to $1,606.2 million, about 55 per cent above the original award. Whether the lane bought what it was supposed to buy is a separate argument: an analysis of Caltrans speed data by Crosstown found southbound morning traffic through the pass moving at 50.1 mph in 2015, during the tail of construction, and 45.7 mph in 2019, well after it.
zh: I-405 上最昂贵的一件事，是加了一条车道。2009 年 4 月，洛杉矶郡都会交通局（Metro）把塞普尔韦达山口改善工程发包给 Kiewit 公司，项目全周期预算 10.34 亿美元，内容是在 I-10 与 US 101 之间新建十英里北行合乘车道，重建桥梁与匝道，并修筑数英里挡土墙和隔音墙。该车道于 2014 年 5 月 23 日通车，比原计划晚了一年多，工程在 2015 年 9 月实质完工。

接着账单来了。Metro 与承包商就工期延误与施工干扰索赔进入具约束力的仲裁，2016 年 12 月，Metro 董事会将项目全周期预算再增加 2.978 亿美元，至 16.062 亿美元，比最初的发包金额高出约 55%。这条车道是否买到了它该买到的东西，则是另一个争论：新闻机构 Crosstown 对加州交通局车速数据的分析显示，山口南行早高峰车速在施工收尾的 2015 年为每小时 50.1 英里，在工程完工许久后的 2019 年为每小时 45.7 英里。

timeline.en: The Sepulveda Pass crossing opens, linking the San Fernando Valley to the Westside.
timeline.zh: 塞普尔韦达山口段通车，连接圣费尔南多谷与西城。

timeline.en: The last eight miles open to I-5 at Irvine, completing the route.
timeline.zh: 最后八英里通车至尔湾的 I-5，全线贯通。

timeline.en: A ten-mile northbound carpool lane opens through Sepulveda Pass after five years of construction.
timeline.zh: 历经五年施工，穿越塞普尔韦达山口的十英里北行合乘车道通车。

timeline.en: Metro settles with its contractor and sets the final widening cost at $1.61 billion.
timeline.zh: Metro 与承包商达成和解，拓宽工程最终造价定为 16.1 亿美元。
